id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|250f: "Phew, that was a shock. I was shoveling as usual when gold monsters suddenly attacked.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2519: "I haven't been so scared since a drunk Viking picked a fight with me years ago.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2528: "Whatever the Gold Plague or monsters, the snow won't wait. So I shovel regularly like this.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2536: "I can barely clear the town's snow, but I believe you can someday clear the darkness covering the world.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|254b: "Gold Plague or monsters aside, the snow won't wait. Daily shoveling is truly hard.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|255a: "But the dark cloud over the world's center has cleared, so I can shovel without worry. Come on, I won't lose to snow!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2580: "Oh, you came all the way across the sea to Sniflheim. Sorry, but it's a wasted trip.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|258a: "...What do I mean? Just go and see, you'll understand at once.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2593: "You saw the frozen castle gate, right? Unless that ice melts, we can't enter the castle.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25a2: "I was to trade with a castle merchant, but the promised date has long passed. ...What to do.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25b2: "What is this blizzard?! Coming to do business here has gone terribly!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25c1: "Honestly! The trade date passed ages ago. What have you been doing?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25cc: "What, the promise is today? Stop joking. Don't you even know today's date?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25db: "This guy has been late a lot... People who are loose with time are a real trouble.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25eb: "Hey, that price is too high! You were late for the trade date, so cut it a bit!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|25f7: "What, you weren't late? Still saying that... Just admit you were late!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2607: "The golden iceberg blocking the sea route to Sniflheim vanished, and ships can come and go.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2613: "The golden icebergs on land are gone too, so you may now reach places you couldn't before.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2626: "A little while ago, a spirited-looking girl set out to sea in a small boat.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2631: "Yggdrasil revived and the sea is safe, but a girl alone at sea... I don't know her destination, and I'm a bit worried.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2647: "A merchant ship bound for Sniflheim was attacked by sea monsters and sank, I hear.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2651: "Luckily the crew is safe, but sea monsters have been active lately, so I worry about future voyages...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2671: "I may not look it, but I'm a mail carrier. I came to deliver a letter to Sniflheim, but the gate is frozen.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|267f: "...Come to think of it, I heard there's a back gate around the castle wall's west side. The east side had nothing, so I'll look there.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2693: "If you're heading to Snaerfelt, be careful.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|269a: "I hear some monsters there breathe blizzards. If you're careless you'll freeze solid.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26ab: "A while ago Heliodor soldiers came and sailed out of the port.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26b3: "That burly guy at the front, I've seen him somewhere. Maybe a famous general.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26c3: "Whoa, what's going on?! The gate ice suddenly melted, I went in, and everyone's living normally!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26d1: "Even if I say the gate was frozen, nobody in town believes me. Strange things do happen.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26eb: "Oh no! I must hurry and deliver a letter to the priest at that church. I forgot completely!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|26fa: "I delivered the letter to the church priest. Next I have to deliver one to the holy land of Arboria on Zwaardsrust...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2709: "To get there you must cross steep snow paths, so I'm a bit hesitant.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2717: "The Luminary's star apparently fell on Gallopolis. Just thinking of such a huge star falling makes me shiver...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2726: "Even I, who wasn't there, feel this way. Gallopolis residents who saw it fall must have been scared stiff.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2744: "I'm traveling to master dances all over the world, but it's too cold! I'll freeze before I learn any!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2757: "I'm dancing to shake off the cold! I normally dance only before an audience, but I can't afford that now!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2764: "But rarely do you see my dance for free! You should thank this cold! Ohoho!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2773: "If you're cold, dance with me! It'll ease the chill! Come on, la♪ la♪ la♪
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2784: "It's colder than before! Dancing can't shake off this cold!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|278e: "But if I stop dancing here, I'll truly freeze, so I'll keep dancing!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27a2: "If I stop dancing here, I'll truly freeze, so I'll keep dancing!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27b6: "Phew, my body's warming up. I thought I'd freeze to death when the blizzard grew, but I survived somehow.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27cf: "Phew, my body's warming up. I thought I'd freeze to death when the blizzard grew, but I survived somehow.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27eb: "I'm a traveling dancer. I travel to master every dance in the world.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|27f6: "The people here are very kind, and when I asked them to teach me Sniflheim dances, they did right away!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2801: "I dance at night, so come watch. Near the bonfire by the castle gate.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2811: "Hee hee, the bard sings Sniflheim songs to my dance. A sound fit for a beautiful snow capital!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|281f: "Listening to the rhythmic voice, my body moves naturally! Come on, dance with me!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2836: "I'm a bounty hunter, known to those in the know. I came here for the Darkspawn. With me here, they're finished.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|284c: "I'm a bounty hunter known to those who know. I came to Sniflheim to find the Darkspawn.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|286b: "I'm a bounty hunter known to those who know. I came to Sniflheim to find the Darkspawn.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2857: "Time to start the Darkspawn hunt. Heh heh, wait for me, Darkspawn. Your life's nearly over.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2884: "Heh heh, Darkspawn, I can't wait to fight and see your skill.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|28a4: "They're definitely close. My gut says so. If you see anyone suspicious, tell me.

id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|291e: "Hmm... I definitely saw it... Do you think the legendary witch really exists in this world?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|292e: "I see... Actually, I saw that witch. Above the central plaza, an ice witch smiling eerily...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|293b: "As the legend says, I thought she'd come to attack Sniflheim, but she vanished before I knew. What is going on...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|294d: "Right, I guess so... Believing an old legend is silly. I must have been mistaken.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2960: "The ice witch I saw. Was she a real witch, or just an illusion...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|296c: "Oh, traveler! Sorry, I didn't notice. We close the castle gate at night. If you want in, come back tomorrow.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|297f: "There's a suspicious blue-haired man at the castle gate. What is he doing? Waiting for someone, maybe?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2992: "The woman who recently started living in the castle is the witch I saw. I wasn't mistaken after all.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|299f: "But when I first saw her, she showed hostility, and now she's quite docile.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ab: "Sorry, we can't let you into the castle at night. If you want in, come back tomorrow.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ad9: "Sorry, we can't let you into the castle at night. If you want in, come back tomorrow.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2b0a: "Sorry, we can't let you into the castle at night. If you want in, come back tomorrow.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ba: "Tsk, the rookie standing beside me dozed off again when I looked away. What an outrageous rookie.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29cb: "You're the traveler from before. Glad you're safe. Charlotte was worried too. Go to the throne room and see her.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29d8: "...Actually, a terrible strange illness is spreading in Sniflheim. Charlotte is quite anxious.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29ea: "You're the traveler from before. Glad you're safe. We can't let you in the castle at night, but Charlotte was worried.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|29f7: "Visit the throne room tomorrow. Charlotte will tell you about the current anomaly in this land.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a09: "The Gold Plague's victims have increased again. In this world cloaked in darkness, how powerless we soldiers are...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a1f: "The Gold Plague's victims have increased again. In this world cloaked in darkness, how powerless we soldiers are...
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a2d: "...And sorry, but we can't let you in the castle at night.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a34: "Though powerless against the plague, we must at least fulfill this duty.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a43: "Thanks to you, we at least prevented the gold monsters from invading the castle.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a5e: "Thanks to you, we at least prevented the gold monsters from invading the castle.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a4d: "But if they attack again, can we hold? They were cunning and tough.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a68: "But if they attack again, can we hold? They were fierce, like pirates.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a72: "To strengthen defenses against them, we must close the castle gate firmly at night.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a80: "Thanks to you, the Gold Plague is gone and the Dark One's army that attacked this land is defeated. Peace has returned.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a9d: "Thanks to you, the Gold Plague is gone and the Dark One's army that attacked this land is defeated. Peace has returned.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2a8e: "Leave this country's defense to us and continue your journey. We're rooting for you.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aac: "We can't let you in the castle at night, but the soldiers inside surely thank you too.
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2abd: "Oh! You're the guest of Queen Charlotte, who saved our country! Perfect timing!
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2aca: "I don't know the details, but the queen seems troubled... Won't you lend her your strength?
id./param/region/r012.pack|npc_ie.bxon|2ae9: "When I passed Snaerfelt's lake before, I saw a huge shadow under the surface, but a dragon... who'd have thought.
